mapper.select: SELECT exclusion_id, topic_id, label, status, created_at FROM course_scope_exclusions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY exclusion_id
SELECT progress_id, topic_id, class_seq, week_no, created_at FROM topic_class_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY progress_id
SELECT material_id FROM ai_message_photos WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND message_id = #{messageId} ORDER BY material_id

SELECT l.link_id, l.material_id, l.course_id, l.material_type, l.linked_at, m.origin FROM material_links l JOIN course_materials m ON m.material_id = l.material_id AND m.user_id = l.user_id WHERE l.user_id = #{userId} AND l.link_id = #{linkId}
SELECT link_id FROM material_links WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND material_id = #{materialId} AND course_id = #{courseId}

SELECT t.topic_id, t.course_id, t.user_mark, p.topic_progress_id, p.status FROM course_topics t LEFT JOIN topic_progress p ON p.topic_id = t.topic_id AND p.user_id = t.user_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.topic_id = #{topicId}

SELECT topic_id, section_id FROM topic_material_links WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND course_id = #{courseId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND section_id <> 0 AND topic_id IN #{id} ORDER BY topic_id, section_id

SELECT e.* FROM learning_events e JOIN learning_event_origins o ON o.user_id = e.user_id AND o.origin_kind = e.origin_kind AND o.origin_id = e.origin_id AND o.current_revision = e.origin_revision WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.origin_kind = #{originKind} AND e.origin_id = #{originId} ORDER BY e.output_no

SELECT e.* FROM learning_events e JOIN learning_event_origins o ON o.user_id = e.user_id AND o.origin_kind = e.origin_kind AND o.origin_id = e.origin_id AND o.current_revision = e.origin_revision WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.course_id = #{courseId} AND e.origin_kind = #{originKind} ORDER BY e.origin_id, e.output_no
SELECT origin_id, current_revision FROM learning_event_origins WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND course_id = #{courseId} AND origin_kind = #{originKind}
SELECT origin_id FROM learning_event_origins WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND course_id = #{courseId} AND origin_kind = #{originKind} AND current_revision > 0

SELECT r.execution_record_id, r.execution_item_id, i.course_id, i.topic_id, r.outcome, r.completion_percent, r.support_level, r.blocker_kind, r.stuck_step, r.ended_at, r.recorded_at, r.created_at FROM execution_records r JOIN execution_items i ON i.execution_item_id = r.execution_item_id AND i.user_id = r.user_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.execution_record_id = #{recordId}

SELECT context_id, course_id, status, source_type, evidence_type, fact_kind, fact_label, help_level, self_level, topic_id, topic_photo_id, section_id, said_at, confirmed_at, created_at, source_message_id FROM user_contexts WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND course_id = #{courseId} AND (fact_kind IN ('PROGRESS', 'EXAM_SCOPE', 'DIFFICULTY', 'RESOLVED') OR source_type = 'SELF_CHECK') ORDER BY context_id

SELECT l.difficulty_context_id, l.resolver_context_id FROM learning_resolution_links l JOIN user_contexts c ON c.context_id = l.difficulty_context_id AND c.user_id = l.user_id WHERE l.user_id = #{userId} AND c.course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY l.difficulty_context_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO learning_resolution_links (difficulty_context_id, resolver_context_id, user_id) VALUES (#{difficultyId}, #{resolverId}, #{userId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE resolver_context_id = VALUES(resolver_context_id)
mapper.select: SELECT r.supersedes_context_id AS difficulty_context_id, r.context_id AS resolver_context_id FROM user_contexts r JOIN user_contexts d ON d.context_id = r.supersedes_context_id AND d.user_id = r.user_id AND d.fact_kind = 'DIFFICULTY' WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.course_id = #{courseId} AND r.fact_kind = 'RESOLVED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM learning_resolution_links l WHERE l.user_id = r.user_id AND l.difficulty_context_id = r.supersedes_context_id) ORDER BY r.context_id
SELECT context_id FROM user_contexts WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND supersedes_context_id = #{contextId} AND source_type = 'USER_EDITED' ORDER BY context_id LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO learning_resolution_links (difficulty_context_id, resolver_context_id, user_id) VALUES (#{difficultyId}, #{resolverId}, #{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE learning_resolution_links SET resolver_context_id = #{toResolverId} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND resolver_context_id = #{fromResolverId}
